name: hero-color-panel
title: Hero Color Panel
blurb: Hero with animated color-panel shader background and AI SDK tech stack badges.
description: Responsive hero section with heading, description, CTA button, and tech badges (Next.js, AI SDK). Animated ColorPanels shader on desktop (1280×720), mobile version (responsive). Context-based composition with many overridable parts.
use_when: AI/SDK-focused landing page or hero that showcases technical credibility with framework badges.
avoid_when: ColorPanels is WebGL-expensive. Needs a sized parent; mobile visual is absolutely positioned. No prefers-reduced-motion…
a11y: Heading has screen-reader title (srTitle). Buttons and links focusable. Shader decorative. No built-in reduced-motion support.
